description: 5G垂直產業應用推動小組(SIG)入選名單 [telecom] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 數位發展部數位產業署. 為加速產業運用5G推動數位轉型，數產署攜手公協會共創5G專頻專網創新應用擴散，由13家公協會分別成立5G垂直產業應用推動小組，推薦該產業之場域業者，整合5G專頻專網服務整合者及通訊傳播應用方案提供者之軟硬能量。 本資料集提供「5G垂直產業應用推動小組(SIG)入選名單」給產業參考使用。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 數位發展部數位產業署. Its tags are 開創事業. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-04-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
